purpose: To resolve database write failures caused by the database being in a read-only transaction state.
when_to_use: Use when OrdersDbWritesFailing alert fires or when INSERT operations fail with psycopg.errors.ReadOnlySqlTransaction.

steps.instruction: Check the database read-only status to confirm the problem.

steps.command: psql -h orders-db -U shop -c "alter system reset default_transaction_read_only" -c "select pg_reload_conf()"
steps.expect: ALTER SYSTEM and message indicating success or configuration reload

steps.instruction: Check the database read-only status again to confirm the fix.

verification: psql -h orders-db -U shop -tA -c "show default_transaction_read_only" returns off

rollback.instruction: To set the database back to read-only mode if needed.
rollback.command: psql -h orders-db -U shop -c "alter system set default_transaction_read_only = 'on'" -c "select pg_reload_conf()"

sop_change: Created a new SOP since no internal SOP covered this issue.
short_description: Database was stuck in read-only transaction mode causing insert failures.
problem_statement: The orders-db went into a read-only transaction mode, causing OrdersDbWritesFailing alerts and preventing INSERT operations.
impact: System health was degraded and database writes were failing.
trigger: OrdersDbWritesFailing alert triggered by psycopg.errors.ReadOnlySqlTransaction: cannot execute INSERT in a read-only transaction.
immediate_resolution: Ran psql -h orders-db -U shop -c "alter system reset default_transaction_read_only" -c "select pg_reload_conf()" after approval.
root_causes: Database default_transaction_read_only configuration was set to on.

timeline.event: Engineer approved running step 2, executing allow_db_writes action and restoring health.
Engineer agreed to write up the new SOP and RCA.

action_items: Save the new SOP to handle future occurrences of OrdersDbWritesFailing.
